programs.title: Matched case-control command tour
programs.description: Runs LIST, FREQ, TABLES, and the bounded 1:1 MATCH candidate in source order against the legacy teaching workbook.
programs.source:
LIST matched_pairs caco pb

FREQ caco

TABLES pb caco

MATCH pb caco MATCHVAR=matched_pairs

programs.title: PB matched-pair analysis
programs.description: Runs only the bounded 1:1 MATCH candidate so its paired counts and exclusions can be reviewed directly.

programs.title: School exposure zero-cell boundary
programs.description: Runs FREQ, TABLES, and MATCH where one discordant direction is zero, producing a positive-infinity matched odds ratio with an explicit boundary state.
programs.source:
FREQ school

TABLES school caco

MATCH school caco MATCHVAR=matched_pairs
